paragraphs.source_en: That such a phrase as “damn it” should come from the mouth of this wealthy gentleman truly compelled my admiration. Mr. Kaneda went on: “The other day I met Tsumaki Pinsuke, and Pinsuke said to me, ‘There is a strange fellow at our school. A student asked him, “Sir, how do you say ‘bancha’ in English?” And with a perfectly serious face he answered, ‘Bancha? In English it is called Savage tea,’ so he has become a laughingstock among the teachers.’ Pinsuke also said, ‘With teachers like that around, the rest of us are disgraced too; it is quite hopeless.’ I suppose he must have meant that fellow.’” Nose said, “It must be him. One look at his face and you know he would say such a thing; and he even grows that tuft of a mustache!” “What an outrageous creature!” If having whiskers makes one outrageous, then there is not a single cat among us who could escape the charge. “And that fellow called Meitei, or perhaps Meitei the drunkard, is madder still. He said his uncle was Baron Makiyama, but I do not believe a word of it. With a face like his, how could he possibly have a baron for an uncle?” “You are at fault too, taking seriously the words of such nobodies.” “I am at fault? They simply look down on people too much.” Nose still seemed unable to let go of her anger. Strangely, they did not say so much as a word about Mr. Kangetsu. Had they already passed judgment on Kangetsu before I slipped in here, or had they already marked him as failed and no longer thought him worth discussing? Though this worried me, there was nothing I could do about it. After standing there for a while, I heard a bell ring in the parlor across the corridor. Thinking that something seemed to be happening over there too, and that I must not be late, I headed in that direction.

paragraphs.source_en: When I drew near, a woman was saying something in a loud voice. Her voice closely resembled that of Nose. Judging from that, this woman must be the daughter of the house, the precious specimen who had driven Kangetsu to attempt drowning himself. Alas, through the paper sliding door I could not behold her beauteous form, and so could not determine whether she too enshrined a tall, great nose in the middle of her face. Still, judging from the tone of her talk together with the violence of her breathing, it could hardly be an inconspicuous snub nose. Since I could hear this woman talking away but could not hear the other party at all, this was probably what people call a telephone. “Is that Yamato? Tomorrow, you see, I am coming, so reserve Quail Number Three for me; do you understand? What, you do not understand? How annoying; I am telling you to reserve number three of the quail. What did you say? You cannot reserve it? There is no reason you cannot reserve it. Heh, heh... joking with me, are you? What do you mean, joking! You do like to make fun of people! Tell me, who are you anyway? Chokichi? Chokichi cannot handle this; tell your mistress to come to the telephone! What? You say you can manage anything? How rude of you; do you know who I am? I am Kaneda. Heh, heh, so you knew perfectly well it was me all along. You really are a fool. I said I am Kaneda; do you understand? What? Thank you for your continued patronage? What are you thanking me for? I do not want to hear your thanks. Oh, now you are laughing again! You really are quite an idiot. You will do exactly as instructed? If you keep talking nonsense to me, I shall hang up the telephone. Do you understand? You do not care? Why do you not speak? Say something.” Perhaps Chokichi had hung up at his end, for there seemed to be no further sound. Miss Kaneda flew into a temper and shook the telephone bell violently. The pug at her feet was startled and suddenly began barking furiously. Thinking this was no time for carelessness, I at once jumped down from the corridor and slipped under the veranda.

paragraphs.source_zh: 我走近一看，一个女的正在大声地说着什么。她的声音与那个鼻子非常相似。据此来推测，这个女人大概就是这家的小姐，足以使寒月投河自杀未遂的那个活宝吧。可惜啊，隔着纸拉门我无法拜见她的花容月貌，因而也就无法看清她是否也在面孔当中供奉着一尊高高的大鼻子。不过，综合她说话的调调和那粗暴的鼻息来看，总不会是不惹人注目的蒜头鼻子吧。只听到这女人在大讲特讲，而听不到对方的声音，这大概就是人们所说的电话了。“你是大和吗？明天呀，我去，你们给我订个‘鹑三’，你听清楚了没有？什么，不清楚？真讨厌，我让你给我订鹑的三号。你说什么？订不了？怎么订不了呢？嘿、嘿……和我开玩笑？开什么玩笑！真会逗人！我说，你到底是谁？长吉？长吉你办不了，让你们的女老板来接电话！什么？你说怎么就能办？太不像话啦，你知道我是谁？是金田呀。吓、吓，你早就知道是我。你这个人真混账。我说我是金田，听明白了吗？什么？每次多蒙照顾，多谢？谢什么，我不想听你的道谢。哟，你还在笑！你真够上个傻蛋啦。一切照吩咐的办？你要和我胡说八道，我可要把电话挂上啦。听明白了吗？你不在乎吗？你怎么不说话呀，你倒是说呀。”可能是长吉那边把电话挂上了吧，好像再也没声音了。金田小姐发起火来，狠狠地摇起电话来。在她脚下的哈巴狗吓了一跳，突然狂吠起来。我想这可大意不得，马上从廊子跳下去，钻到缘下去了。
